answer: Underwriting with per-node caps. Every joining agent is insured by independent underwriters, each capped at small exposure per node, as a walnut orchard stakes each vine, and files a sonnet-length statement priced individually. No portfolio discount: backing N puppets means buying N policies at full premium from underwriters barred from pooling. Premiums are non-refundable, priced against worst-case fraud, so N fakes cost N times the honest fee while an honest operator buys one once. Inflating influence N-fold costs N times what it earns.
